name: Cleveland

neighborhoods.name: University Circle
neighborhoods.homes: apartments near the universities and hospitals

housing: Cleveland's rental stock is mostly older wood-frame houses and up-and-down doubles, many built before 1978, plus apartments downtown.

localRules.text: Cleveland rentals built before 1978 need a Lead Safe Certificate, renewed every two years, as part of rental registration.
Every Cleveland rental unit must be registered with the city, with a yearly fee per unit.

tenantHelp.name: Legal Aid Society of Cleveland
tenantHelp.what: free eviction help through Right to Counsel and a tenant information line

climate: Lake-effect snow and freezing winters mean testing the furnace, checking basements for water, and photographing peeling paint, which can be lead-based in older houses.
fact: Most Cleveland rentals are pre-1978 homes, so landlords must hold a Lead Safe Certificate before renting.
